steps.title: Look at a column
steps.text: Click a column header to see how its values are spread.

steps.title: Pick what to predict
steps.text: Choose the column you want the model to guess.

steps.title: Train
steps.text: Train the model. The tour goes on when training finishes.

steps.title: Test it
steps.text: Open the testing view to see how well the model predicts.
